title: Grade 3 French — Tue, Jun 24
description: À l'école — Day 2 of 5: School places (les endroits de l'école)
subject: french

questions.question: What is 'la salle de classe' in English?
questions.explanation: 'La salle de classe' = the classroom. 'Salle' = room/hall; 'de classe' = of class.

questions.question: Where do you go to borrow books in French school? 'La ___'
questions.explanation: 'La bibliothèque' = the library. 'La cantine' = the canteen/cafeteria. 'La cour' = the playground/courtyard. 'Le gymnase' = the gym.

questions.question: What is 'la cour de récréation'?
questions.explanation: 'La cour de récréation' = the playground (recreation yard). Often just called 'la cour.'

questions.question: Where do you eat lunch at school in France? 'Je mange à ___'
questions.explanation: 'La cantine' = the school canteen/cafeteria. 'Je mange à la cantine.' = I eat at the canteen.

questions.question: What is 'le couloir'?
questions.explanation: 'Le couloir' = the corridor or hallway (the passage between classrooms).

questions.question: Fill in: 'Pendant la récréation, je joue dans ___ .' (During break, I play in the ___)
questions.explanation: 'Je joue dans la cour.' = I play in the playground/yard. 'La cour' (or 'la cour de récréation') is where students play during break.

questions.question: Where does the school principal (le directeur/la directrice) usually work?
questions.explanation: 'Le bureau du directeur' = the principal's office. 'Bureau' = office/desk.

questions.question: Match place to activity: 'Je lis des livres → ___ '
questions.explanation: 'Je lis des livres' = I read books → 'la bibliothèque' (the library). Reading happens in the library.

questions.question: What is 'le gymnase'?
questions.explanation: 'Le gymnase' = the gym or sports hall where PE (l'éducation physique) lessons take place.

questions.question: Translate: 'I go to the library to read.'
options: Je vais à la cantine pour manger.
Je vais à la bibliothèque pour lire.
Je vais au gymnase pour lire.
Je vais dans la cour pour lire.
questions.explanation: 'Je vais à la bibliothèque pour lire.' = I go to the library to read. 'Pour + infinitive' = in order to (do something).

questions.question: What is 'la salle de sport'?
questions.explanation: 'La salle de sport' = the sports hall / PE room. Similar to 'le gymnase.'

questions.question: How do you say 'I am in the classroom' in French?
options: Je suis dans la salle de classe.
questions.explanation: 'Je suis dans la salle de classe.' = I am in the classroom. 'Je suis' = I am; 'dans' = in.

questions.question: Describe your school route: 'Je quitte ___ et je vais dans ___.' (I leave the classroom and go to the canteen.)
options: la cantine, la salle de classe
la salle de classe, la cantine
questions.explanation: 'Je quitte la salle de classe et je vais dans la cantine.' = I leave the classroom and go to the canteen.

questions.question: What is the French word for 'staffroom' (where teachers take breaks)?
questions.explanation: 'La salle des professeurs' = the staffroom (literally: the teachers' room). 'Des professeurs' = of the teachers.

questions.question: Write a sentence saying where you go after each activity. Best answer:
options: Après les cours, je vais dans la cour pour jouer. Ensuite, je vais à la cantine pour manger.
questions.explanation: 'Après les cours, je vais dans la cour pour jouer. Ensuite, je vais à la cantine pour manger.' uses 'après' (after), 'pour + infinitive' (to/in order to) and 'ensuite' (then/next) — good connectors.
